data.body:
**[P2] Enforce the deadline during connection establishment**

`conn.sock` remains `None` while `socket.create_connection()` resolves DNS and tries addresses, so expiry cannot interrupt that work. Its timeout applies separately to each address; a later address can even connect after expiry and complete successfully because `expired` is only checked after an exception. Use a deadline-aware connection routine that exposes and closes the in-flight socket, applies the remaining time, and checks expiry before sending and returning. Add a test with a stalled first address and a reachable second address.
